news.text: Possible formation #FiorentinaJuveFiorentina (4-3-2-1): De Gea, Jiménez, Dragusin, Viery, Joao Mario; Ndour, Fagioli, Brescianini; Mastantuono, Njie; Pellegrino.JUVENTUS (3-4-2-1): Vicario, Gatti, Bremer, Lucumí; Kalulu, McKennie, Douglas Luiz, Cabal; Alajbegovic, Kolo Muani; Woltemade.[Mirko Di Natale]
🔴 Probable #Juventus lineup: Vicario; Gatti, Bremer, Lucumi; Kalulu, McKennie, Douglas Luiz, Cabal; Kolo Muani, Woltemade, Alajbegovic.[Sky Sport via @juventusinsidernews]
🚑 #Juventus ranks first among the top 5 European leagues in the number of injured players (9) and total market value currently in the treatment room (€245M).[@TMit_news via @PuebloJ]

👀 "#Carnesecchi is unlikely to be bought by a big club in Italy.He was linked with #Juventus many times, but in recent mercato windows other decisions were made for the goal.His path could lead him to the Premier League: #ManchesterUnited is in the pole position and the deal could reach a successful conclusion."[@NicoSchira on YouTube via @PuebloJ]

👀 "There are no records of direct or indirect contact between #Juventus and #Conte.When a manager is free, all it takes is a call, and if both parties are interested, a deal can be closed even in half an hour.He is currently waiting for the right opportunity, the right club and the right project, but he is in no hurry.For now, he is not in talks with any club."[@FabrizioRomano on YouTube via @PuebloJ]

🔛❗️#Juventus is working on the forward mercato. The main targets are #Balogun and #Sesko, although they would require large investments. The management is also evaluating other profiles: among these, #Brobbey has emerged. The scouts are also monitoring the Italian mercato, with particular attention on #Raimondo. Another name reported is #Ebnoutalib from #Frankfurt.[Niccolò Ceccarini - TMW via @juventusinsidernews]

👀🆙 #Spalletti is considering reintroducing the #Woltemade-#KoloMuani-#Alajbegovic trident. This tactical solution has yielded excellent results: the Frenchman found greater freedom, the German provided quality and physical presence, while the Bosnian created dangerous opportunities. The manager could also modify positions based on the team's balance and the return of #McKennie.[Gazzetta dello Sport via @juventusinsidernews]
Forwarded from (Pueblo Juve Workflow)📋 La probable alineación titular de la #Juventus para el #FiorentinaJuventus según @DiMarzio🪅 @PuebloJ

🧐⁉️ #Spalletti is trying to get the best out of the #KoloMuani-#Woltemade duo, but they perform better when they play together and neither is a pure center-forward: the Frenchman is more dangerous when exploring spaces created by another striker, while the German is better at linking play and distributing the ball. Therefore, in January, the club could intervene: #Sorloth and #Balogun among the main candidates.[TuttoSport via @juventusinsidernews]

On the eve of #FiorentinaJuve ⚠️❌ #Cambiaso out due to fatigue in his right thigh✅ #Çelik and #McKennie completed the entire training session with the group🚦#Conceição partially with the team@junews24com[Marco Baridon]

🇮🇹🤔 #Juventus has not confirmed a muscle fatigue issue for #Cambiaso: therefore, he would still have a chance of being called up for the away match in Florence. It clearly remains to be seen whether, in the event of a call-up, he will start or if #Spalletti will decide to manage his energy levels, preferring to start with #Cabal from the 1st minute.[TuttoJuve via @juventusinsidernews]

🇮🇹⚠️ #Cambiaso will not be available against #Fiorentina due to muscle fatigue. However, #Spalletti hopes to recover #McKennie and #Çelik. The recovery of #Conceição is not complicated, as he is still dealing with a shoulder dislocation.[Gazzetta dello Sport via @juventusinsidernews]
@GJustjuve posted a photo

❌🇮🇹 Cambiaso ruled out for Fiorentina: the full-back returned from the Netherlands with a minor injury (fatigue) and will not be available for the away game at the Franchi.[Juventus_reborn via Gazzetta]

👀 "#JoaoMario will probably not be bought by #Fiorentina, who could already try to return him to Turin in January.#Juventus could also keep him, perhaps in place of #Cabal, who is disappointing.The Colombian could then leave, while the Portuguese could return, although not necessarily to stay: he could be placed at another club."[@NicoSchira on YouTube via @PuebloJ]

👀 "The requests of Luciano #Spalletti, #Juventus manager, for the winter mercato are clear:THE REQUESTS▪️ A left-back▫️ A forward, if #KoloMuani and #Woltemade fail to get going▪️ Depending on injuries, a midfielder to replace #Locatelli or #ThuramThese are the needs that #Carnevali, #Ottolini and #Massara will have to address."[@NicoSchira on YouTube via @PuebloJ]
